question: Please tell us a heartwarming episode from before Garfiel and Otto solidified their relationship after the earthspider escapade! I was late in asking, so I'd be very happy if you could answer...
answer: After the earthspider, the two of them took to battling on the chatrange board, but also due to the effect of the earthspider event, Garfiel had always felt it was difficult to deal with Otto. If he could have won on the chatrange board, he might have been able to dispel that, but that didn't work out either. It was the next incident that resolved that problem.
